description: Write or change the coach's public page, as the Public page tab's form does. Fields left out keep their value. handle: the address, tripeak.app/c/<handle> (lower-case letters, digits, hyphens). published: true puts it online — it needs a headline, and athletes can only apply once Stripe is set up (start_payment_setup) and there is an offer. bio is Markdown (## heading, **bold**, *italic*, - lists, > quote, [link](https://…)): write it to sell — who they coach, how, what an athlete gets each week. accent colours the page: coral, ocean, forest, violet, sunset, graphite. highlights: up to 4 numbers they are proud of, {value: "40", label: "Ironman finishers"}. testimonials: up to 6 athletes' words, {quote, name, detail}. credentials: qualifications, one per item. links: https addresses for website, instagram, strava, youtube. disciplines: any of triathlon, duathlon, running, trail, cycling, gravel, swimming, xcski. Pictures go on with upload_page_image. Show the coach the text before publishing.

bio.description: How they coach, who for, what an athlete gets
